description.p: Twinverse is an open-source application for Linux and SteamOS that lets you create and manage up to 8 isolated Steam Big Picture instances simultaneously. Multiple players can enjoy their game libraries on a single computer—in splitscreen or across multiple monitors—with dedicated controllers, full isolated Steam Input, mid-session controller reconnection, dedicated audio outputs, home directories, and private LAN IPv4 addresses.
Key Features:

ul.li: Up to 8 Isolated Instances: Run multiple Steam clients simultaneously with custom player names, per-player inclusion toggles, and automatic crash/session recovery

Per-Monitor Tiling & Drag-and-Drop Studio: Choose from 6 visual templates per display (Fullscreen, Columns, Rows, Main left, Main top, Grid — up to 4 players per monitor) and drag players directly between spaces

Full Steam Input & Hotplug Controller Isolation: Pure-Rust userspace /dev/uinput and libudev virtualization keeps Steam Input strictly per-instance, automatically reconnects unplugged controllers mid-session, isolates identical sibling controllers, and dynamically filters /dev/hidraw*
Dedicated Audio Outputs: Route each player's audio to a separate PipeWire/PulseAudio sink with per-instance PipeWire capture isolation

Rootless Per-Instance Networking (pasta): Assigns each instance its own free LAN IPv4 address (or optional fixed Guest IP) to prevent port conflicts and Steam relays, with an Isolate network preference toggle
Dedicated Home Directories & Sandbox Shell: Isolated home_1–home_8 folders with quick access to browse files or launch a sandboxed terminal
Shared Game Library & Any Proton: Shares your host steamapps/common/ and compatibilitytools.d/ (including ProtonGE) so games are never downloaded twice
Play Different Games Simultaneously: Every instance is independent—players do not need to play the same title

description.p: How it Works:

Twinverse dynamically assembles a nested, rootless isolation stack for every player: a pure-Rust host input supervisor (twinverse-input-bridge) for controller hotplug and hidraw filtering, optional pasta per-instance networking, Bubblewrap (bwrap) for filesystem and device sandboxing with userspace virtual /dev/uinput and libudev shims, and Gamescope for per-tile display rendering and KDE Plasma 6 / KWin auto-tiling.

description.p: Early alpha preview of Twinverse 2.0 featuring the redesigned three-pane Session Studio interface (Party Roster, Session Layout canvas, and collapsible Player Setup inspector).
Add per-monitor tiling templates (Fullscreen, Columns, Rows, Main Left, Main Top, and Grid) with native thumbnails, crisp 1:1 integer-pixel framing, and animated drag-and-drop player placement.
Add editable player names, direct player add/remove controls, bundled custom symbolic icons, redesigned floating toast notifications, and a WCAG AA/AAA light mode palette.
Give each isolated instance its own IPv4 address with pasta, track SteamRT3 steamwebhelper startup and termination safely across descendant sessions, and recover surviving instances across restarts.
Rewrite logging on the Python standard library under the XDG state directory with per-instance logs, retention limits, diagnostics, and crash logging.
Improve AppImage compatibility with KWin 6.8 (linux-dmabuf v5) and desktop theme, cursor, and font integration.
Add optional per-instance network isolation with pasta, keeping internet access and requiring no root.
Fix Steam's remote capture so it records this instance's Gamescope instead of the host's.
Set the Gamescope refresh rate automatically from the monitor each instance was assigned.
Allow all eight instances in fullscreen and reuse the first monitor when an instance has none of its own.
Run Gamescope, MangoApp and Steam inside the same sandbox and expose the limiter file to Proton.
Apply the splitscreen menu overlay repair on every instance, including those running the SteamRT3 client.
Enable AppImage updates through AppImageUpdate and compatible tools using embedded update information and a matching zsync file.
Users of earlier AppImages must download this version manually once to enable future updates.
Fix controller navigation of the Steam side menus while a game runs in splitscreen instances.
Turn off Steam Input in each instance on its first launch.
Build the AppImage against glibc 2.35 in a container and verify in CI that it opens a window before release.
Fix Steam performance-menu control of MangoApp and prevent duplicated overlay elements.
Add per-player terminals, synchronize game manifests, and fix controller navigation during Steam UI startup.
Initial public release stable.
